// fishSpecies: Give each fish one of eight species with its own shape and pattern, derived from its name (default: false)
// uiStyle: 'classic' (name cards with health bar and age, light panels when the lights are on) or 'minimal' (name with health dots and the age below it, as plain text close to the fish, and dark side panels also with the lights on)
// showPanels: Show or hide each side panel. 'legends' only appears when a deceased fish is among the three oldest, 'memorial' only when a fish has died
// hungerRate: Health loss per 10 min from hunger (default: 0.167, ~4 days to die)
// diseaseRate: Extra health loss per 10 min when sick and not medicated (default: 0.083)
